why_the_challenge_added_zero_rows_to_THI.headline: the challenge produced one first-party-verified pet-friendly hotel, and it is deliberately NOT in the clean list
why_the_challenge_added_zero_rows_to_THI.reason: Tru by Hilton Indianapolis Lawrence is not an unresolved row of the pinned census -- it is a property the census does not contain at all. Admitting a new identity to a contract-pinned census is a founder decision with its own census effect, not an application of policy evidence to an existing row. Putting it in the clean inventory would smuggle a census admission through a policy gate.
why_the_challenge_added_zero_rows_to_THI.where_it_is_instead: CENSUS_ADMISSION_CANDIDATES below, and founder item A-022-1
why_the_challenge_added_zero_rows_to_THI.the_honest_reading: a competitor census challenge is a DISCOVERY lane. It finds identities. It does not, by itself, produce publishable rows, and this order did not manufacture any.
